Union Cemetery 3D Timeline

Starts above the terrain in a 3D oblique aerial view. Left-drag uses a free trackball orbit; Shift-drag or right-drag pans and the wheel zooms. Burial placement uses cemetery-style rows with wider head-to-head depth than side-to-side spacing, road exclusion, and chronology-independent lot assignment.

Placement / road checkBurial rows now use a plot proportion based on approximately 4 ft side-to-side and at least 6 ft from a stone into the burial space. Stones are deliberately narrower than the plot width. Records sharing a lot are kept near one another as family-plot clusters, while road surfaces remain exclusion zones. Large deciduous trees are added in open turf as landscape context and now grow with the timeline from provisional establishment dates; those dates can be replaced when historic tree-age data is available.
